preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 500 and 1 <= m <= 500 for n, m in [tuple(map(int, stdin.split()))])
preconditions.description: Input dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m and all(0 <= int(x) <= 1023 for x in row) for row in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each row has exactly m elements, each a non-negative integer between 0 and 1023 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NIE' if all(all(x == 0 for x in row) for row in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) else stdout.strip() == 'TAK'
postconditions.description: Output is 'NIE' if and only if all elements in the matrix are zero; otherwise, output starts with 'TAK'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.count('\n') == 2 and stdout.splitlines()[1].strip() != '' if 'TAK' in stdout else stdout.count('\n') == 1
postconditions.description: If 'TAK' is output, it is followed by exactly one line containing n integers (1 ≤ c_j ≤ m).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(c) <= m for c in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()) if 'TAK' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: Each selected column index c_j is between 1 and m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: (lambda: (lambda rows, cols: any((int(rows[i][int(cols[i])-1]) for i in range(len(rows)))) > 0 for cols in product(*[range(1, m+1) for _ in range(n)])))(stdin.splitlines()[1:], stdout.splitlines()[1].split()) if 'TAK' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: The XOR of selected elements (one per row) is strictly greater than zero.
